content.title: Purple Biotech Unveils Promising Biomarker for Cancer Therapy
content.summary: Purple Biotech (PPBT) has released an update. Purple Biotech has identified a new serum biomarker, CEACAM1, which may significantly enhance the efficacy of their oncology therapeutic candidate, CM24, for treating metastatic pancreatic cancer. Patients with certain levels of this biomarker showed a 79% reduction in the risk of death and improved survival rates when treated with CM24 in combination with chemotherapy.
